name: NROL-136
destination_explanation: Most of the satellites working today are down here, which has made this by far the most crowded stretch of space around the planet.
slot_a_text: Fifteenth batch of satellites for a reconnaissance satellite constellation built by SpaceX and Northrop Grumman for the National Reconnaissance Office to provide imaging and other reconnaissance capabilities.
slot_b_text: That was SpaceX's 129th launch of the year, 748th all time. It works out to a launch every other day. Falcon 9 is on a 350-flight success streak. Worldwide, it was attempt number 271 of the year.
